_readme: TMP_009 iteration 13 — subject-prompt rewrite. Iter 12 surfaced KEY finding: undergrowth/ground bias is subject-level (the phrase 'alpine dwarf shrub cluster' carries a botanical-illustration prior). This iteration tests the cheapest possible attack: rewrite ONLY `prompt_subject` to use language patterns that bring isolated-product-photo priors instead — 'studio product photography', 'topiary', 'cultivated', 'seamless backdrop'. Everything else verbatim iter 6 (peak baseline): same base, zero LoRA, same positive template, same negative, same biome hints, same fixture. Single-variable test of subject-level prior hypothesis.
prompt_template: A single isolated bush sprite asset for a fantasy game, ONE specimen alone, the {subject}, centered on a pure white empty background with nothing else, no landscape, no scene, no multiple plants, no other objects, no ground tile, viewed from an isometric 2.5D camera angle, Heroes of Might and Magic III inspired hand-painted readability, biome palette cue applied only to foliage colours: {biome_hint}
